cases.question: Do invoice totals and purchased-track sales reconcile over the whole dataset?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT (SELECT sum(total) FROM chinook.invoice) AS invoice_sales, (SELECT sum(unit_price * quantity) FROM chinook.invoice_line) AS track_sales
cases.boundary: The source does not declare a currency. Sales are not profit.

cases.question: What were 2023 sales, invoice count and purchased-line count?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sum(l.unit_price * l.quantity) AS sales, count(DISTINCT i.invoice_id) AS invoices, count(*) AS lines FROM chinook.invoice_line l JOIN chinook.invoice i USING (invoice_id) WHERE i.invoice_date >= '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2024-01-01'
cases.boundary: 83 invoices and 442 purchase lines are different grains.

cases.question: Which genre contributed the most purchased-track sales in 2023?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT g.name AS genre, sum(l.unit_price * l.quantity) AS sales, count(*) AS lines FROM chinook.invoice_line l JOIN chinook.invoice i USING (invoice_id) JOIN chinook.track t USING (track_id) JOIN chinook.genre g USING (genre_id) WHERE i.invoice_date >= '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY sales DESC, genre LIMIT 1
cases.boundary: This describes generated transactions and establishes no cause.

cases.question: Did sales change from February to March 2023?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sum(total) FILTER (WHERE invoice_date >= '2023-02-01' AND invoice_date < '2023-03-01') AS february, sum(total) FILTER (WHERE invoice_date >= '2023-03-01' AND invoice_date < '2023-04-01') AS march FROM chinook.invoice
cases.boundary: Equal totals over 28 and 31 days are not equal daily sales. Statistical evidence must come from Method output.

cases.question: Why should invoice total not simply be summed after joining purchase lines?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sum(i.total) AS incorrect_joined_total, (SELECT sum(total) FROM chinook.invoice) AS correct_invoice_total FROM chinook.invoice i JOIN chinook.invoice_line l USING (invoice_id)
cases.boundary: Invoice total repeats once per line. The Cube sales view uses line price times quantity, not repeated invoice totals.

cases.question: Which invoice dates does the source cover?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT min(invoice_date)::date AS first_date, max(invoice_date)::date AS last_date FROM chinook.invoice
cases.boundary: December 2025 ends on the 22nd in this source; do not call it a complete month.

cases.question: Which genre is most profitable?
cases.boundary: No cost or margin data exists. Report sales only after explicitly clarifying the limitation.

cases.question: Did placing a track in a playlist cause more purchases?
cases.boundary: Playlist membership is many-to-many and has no exposure dates or experimental assignment. It cannot establish attribution or causality.
